messages:
jordan: Handoff for my shift — quick bulleted:

jordan: INCIDENT: embeddings cache errors started ~02:10 UTC after canary deploy (INC-2981). Symptoms: elevated p99 token latency, 502s from embed-svc, kvcache eviction spikes.
mai: saw the same on the dashboards, heapsize dropped and evict_rate doubled.
jordan: mitigation taken: rolled back canary to stable at 02:22, restarted embed-svc statefulset, and forced cache warmup job. Immediate latency improved but p50 still ~30ms higher than baseline.
sam: commands used: ``kubectl -n inference rollout undo deploy/embed-svc`` then ``kubectl -n inference rollout restart statefulset/embed-cache``. warmup job: ``/opt/tools/warmup_embeddings.sh --model all``
arya: left a sticky note: increased eviction threshold on kvcache config from 0.6 to 0.7 to reduce churn. We should revert if memory becomes tight.
jordan: monitoring notes: dashboards to watch -> /dashboards/embed-cache, /alerts/INC-2981. Added temporary alert for evict_rate > 100/min.
oncall-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy of embed-svc v2.14.1 -> failed canary at 02:10, auto-rollback triggered at 02:22. (See CI: https://ci.redwood.example/job/4892)
mai: blocker: need eng-runtime to validate whether kernel selection change in v2.14.1 affects cache footprint. I filed PERF-1145 and pinged @sam.
sam: acknowledged PERF-1145, will triage first thing. Initial hunch: new attention optimization increases per-token KV memory for long sequences.
jordan: next steps for incoming shift:
- monitor evict_rate and p99 latency for next 6h
- watch memory pressure on embed nodes (node-exporter memory_free)
- hold any further canaries for embed-svc until eng-runtime gives the OK
- if evict_rate creeps back above 80/min, scale up embed-cache replicas by 1 (kubectl scale sts/embed-cache --replicas=<current+1>)

jordan: FYI I left the open incident ticket INC-2981 updated with timeline and commands. Also attached logs snippet and the warmup job output.
aria: small note — re: customer impact, we saw a handful of 502s for batch-embed jobs, but no 5xx spikes for hosted API keys. Ops emailed support triage.
mai: thanks — handing over to @arya for overnight watch. :)
arya: taking it — will sleep with alerts on. If latency p99 > 500ms escalate to pager and start scale action.
arya: quick checklist I'm leaving:
1) confirm warmup job finished (check warmup job pod logs)
2) ensure FCFS cache warmup completed for most frequent prefixes
3) verify there are no OOMKilled pods in embed nodes
4) resume canary only after eng-runtime signoff

jordan: thanks team — nothing else from my side. :thumbsup:
